_doc: The dev/research sample pool — the standing set every dev run is reviewed against. Decision LOCKED 2026-06-20 (metric-engine-plan.md §6): the 25 NTEE-P base docs + ~8 coverage docs (~5 infographic-heavy, ~3 financial-heavy). sha8 keys; resolve to full content_sha256 at load time.

coverage_add_8._status: selection deferred to Phase 1 (when the dev harness consumes the pool). Criteria below.

coverage_criteria.infographic_heavy: docs with high figure/picture density (stress the mispairing + garble checks). Pick from corpus by figure-per-page count, excluding the base 25.
coverage_criteria.financial_heavy: docs dominated by financial tables (stress the financial-reject + measurable checks: publish top-line totals, reject per-line grant amounts). Useful as a fixture even though financial-statement-only reports are excluded from the product corpus.
